ja: 龍 神 丸 の 魂 を 受 け 継 ぐ 新 た な 魔 神、Ｈ Ｇ に 降 臨 ！
『魔神英雄伝ワタル2』より、魔神 龍星丸が新規造形でＨＧシリーズから商品化。
特徴的な飛龍形態への変形も、各所ギミックと一部パーツの組み換えで再現。
関節には引き出し式機構を搭載しボリューム感のある造形ながら剣の両手持ちが可能。
付属する光龍剣の宝玉はジュエルシールを採用。飛龍形態時のディスプレイを可能にする台座が付属。
●　金色の魔神 龍星丸を新規造形でＨＧシリーズから商品化。
龍星丸の特徴的なフォルムを新規造形でＨＧシリーズから商品化、肩部の色分けは成形色によりパーツ分割で再現。
金色部分にはゴールドの成形色を採用し神々しさを演出。
●　龍星丸の真の姿「飛龍」への変形を再現
龍星丸の真の姿である「飛龍」への変形ギミックを搭載。各所ギミックと一部パーツの組み換えで再現。
付属のディスプレイ台座により、飛龍形態のディスプレイが可能。
●　「光龍剣」が付属！
宝玉部分にジュエルシールを採用。左右武器持ち手、左右平手が付属。
●　引き出し式ギミックで両手持ちが可能！
肩部には引き出し式の可動機構を搭載。胴体側の前後スイング機構も搭載しており「光龍剣」を両手持ちすることが可能。
●フルカラーパッケージでお届け！
付属武装：光龍剣
付属物：ディスプレイ台座

en: A new demon that inherits the soul of Ryujinmaru has descended on HG!
From "Mashin Hero Wataru 2", Majin Ryuuseimaru has been commercialized from the HG series with a new model.
The transformation into the characteristic flying dragon form is also reproduced through gimmicks and rearrangement of some parts.
The joints are equipped with pull-out mechanisms, making it possible to hold the sword with both hands while creating a voluminous shape.
The included Koryuken jewel uses a jewel seal. A pedestal is included to enable display in Hiryu form.
● Golden Genie Ryuseimaru is commercialized from the HG series with a new model.

The distinctive form of Ryuseimaru has been commercialized from the HG series with new modeling, and the color coding of the shoulders is reproduced by dividing the parts depending on the molding color.
The golden part uses gold molding color to create a divine look.
● Reproduce the transformation of Ryuseimaru into its true form "Hiryu"
Equipped with a gimmick that transforms Ryuseimaru into his true form "Hiryu". Reproduced with gimmicks and rearrangement of some parts.
The included display pedestal allows for display in Hiryu form.
● "Koryuken" is included!
Jewel Seal is used for the jewel part. Left and right weapon holders and left and right palms are included.
● Can be held with both hands with pull-out gimmick!
Equipped with a pull-out movable mechanism on the shoulder. It is also equipped with a back and forth swing mechanism on the torso side, allowing it to hold the "Koryuken" with both hands.
●Delivered in full color package!
Attached weapon: Light dragon sword
Accessories: Display pedestal
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE/PUR
・No adhesive is used for assembly
